refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns &false; if no session is active, &true; otherwise. &true; is also returned when nothing was cleared, because $_SESSION is no longer the session array, for example after $_SESSION = 'str'; or unset($_SESSION);.

&reftitle.notes;
If $_SESSION is used, use unset to unregister a session variable, i.e. unset($_SESSION['varname']);.
Do NOT unset the whole $_SESSION with unset($_SESSION) as this will disable the registering of session variables through the $_SESSION superglobal.
session_unset clears the $_SESSION array in place, whereas $_SESSION = [] assigns a new array. A copy of $_SESSION taken earlier keeps its content.
This function works only if a session is active. It will not clear the $_SESSION array if the session has not been started yet or has already been destroyed. Use $_SESSION = [] to unset all session variables even if the session is not active.
